healthSync.appleSummary: Reads selected data from Apple Health and syncs it to your self-hosted server.
healthSync.connectSummary: Reads selected data from Health Connect and syncs it to your self-hosted server.
healthSync.appleDetail:
SparkyFitness reads the health data you select below using Apple Health (HealthKit). If sync is enabled, data is synchronized only between your device and your self-hosted SparkyFitness server (manual or background).

Manage or remove access in Settings → Health → Data Access & Devices → SparkyFitnessMobile
healthSync.connectDetail: SparkyFitness reads the health data you select below using Health Connect. If sync is enabled, data is synchronized only between your device and your self-hosted SparkyFitness server (manual or background).
healthSync.title: Health Data to Sync
healthSync.consultProfessional: Consult a healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
healthSync.batteryNote: Enabling many health metrics may increase battery usage. Each enabled metric allows the app to wake in the background when new data is available.
healthSync.writeSummary: Syncs the data you log in SparkyFitness out to {{store}}, keeping the two in sync.
healthSync.syncMetricHint: Toggles synchronization for this health metric.
healthSync.enableAllHint: Toggles synchronization for all health metrics.
healthSync.writeMetricHint: Toggles writing this metric to the health store.

calorieSettings.title: Calorie & BMR Settings
calorieSettings.modeDescription: Controls how your daily calorie goal adjusts based on activity.
calorieSettings.exerciseCaloriesDescription: How much of your exercise calories are added back to your daily goal.
calorieSettings.activityBaseline: Used as a baseline for TDEE.
calorieSettings.adaptiveFallback: Acts as a fallback until you have enough tracking data.
calorieSettings.negativeDescription: Lower your daily goal when you burn less than expected.
calorieSettings.includeRestingDescription: Include your baseline energy (BMR) in net calculations.
calorieSettings.externalDescription: Uses {{source}} {{metric}} when available. Otherwise, the selected formula will be used.
calorieSettings.iosNote: The synced value already includes light daily activity, so you may want to set
calorieSettings.iosNoteContinuation: your Activity Level to None (×1.0) to avoid counting it twice.
